info.name: Finalcad One API
info.description:
Finalcad One platform is composed of iOS & Android mobile apps, a web app (europe or asian), a CAD plugin and Finalcad One API. The latter is allowing organizations and projects management through API.
On one hand, you can customize connections to your own system.
On the other hand, our API automates your projects setups and ease the mass management, for groups creation for instance. At the end Finalcad One API increases harmonisation of practice.

Getting started

To access the Finalcad One API, the client organization must be subscribed to the "Enterprise" offer.
This offer makes it possible to obtain a API Key which will allow access to the API.

In addition, for the management of the authorizations of the different users who can use the APIs with the API Key, the user must (physical or service account) be authenticated on our platform to obtain an OAuth2.0 token which will give him his rights.

Prerequisite

Using Finalcad One API is restricted to organizations with a subscription to Entreprise licence.

API Key usage

The API Key will be provided by Finalcad once the organization's eligibility to access API services has been validated. This API Key serves as the identification method for the calling organization throughout all API calls. It should be included in theX-API-Key header for each call.

To authenticate, a token must be included in the Authorization header using the following format: Authorization: token your_api_key
Or if you use the legacy api key: Authorization: bearer your_user_token

It is crucial that this key remains confidential and is not publicly
disclosed. Sharing the key without the organization's consent may result in unauthorized usage by third parties

Get your API Key

You can request the generation of an apikey by connecting to our web site and going to the user menu

and you will get your apikey

You can revoke your API key using the same menu option.

Eligility rule : the user must be an administrator for at least one organization with the offer entreprise.

Stay in touch

Support contact

We are here to support you!
Our priority is to give you full autonomy in your organization and project management. In case of need, we are nonetheless here to ensure that you never feel lost. If you encounter a problem, feel free to contact our support team by email.

Feature request

We believe in a virtuous circle, in which everyone can have a great idea and so should be heard. If you have suggestions, enhancement idea or feature request, please contact our product and CSM team:

item.name: Uses cases
item.description:
Our Public APIs allow creativity to flourish as any developer can rely on the platform to extend the usefulness of existing software and bring new solutions to all users. Finalcad One can be integrated with various software to quickly reduce copy and paste, as well as data re-entry with all the transcription errors and associated headaches. A majority of large publishers have adopted APIs, you can already connect solutions such as:

  • Enterprise Resource Management Systems

  • Human Resources Information Systems

  • Customer Relationship Management Systems

  • Electronic Document Management Systems

  • Business Intelligence Softwares

Here, we described five examples of integration you can develop from our Public API. Let’s create new use cases to respond to your business case!

A project for each construction site

You can connect your identification system for each of your business cases referenced by your ERP with the Finalcad One platform keeping the same referential. Thus, the IT department eliminates manual entry for field teams.

Easy users accesses

User authentication and invitation are therefore key factors in facilitating deployment. Connecting your own authentication system by SSO allows each user of your company not to recreate a username and password.

Ensure each user would get access at the good level of access on the Finalcad platform connecting it with your Active Directory. The IT department will be sure safety procedures are respected for data confidentiality.

Custom libraries for everyone

You can create specific business libraries from your Knowledge Database to implement the same referential integrity for any project. The QHSE department will be sure procedures would be correctly applied on site such as quality inspections, quality controls, safety audits …

The right suppliers on each construction site

You are now able to link the company library of each project with suppliers selected into your ERP. You eliminate the setting by the site teams and you provide high added value information for your Purchasing departments which will be able to benchmark companies by business, region and type of work.

The right blueprint at the right time

You can interface your EDM with Finalcad One Location module to guarantee the digital continuity between the Design Office and the Field. Creating the same structure in both softwares, blueprints would be automatically updated once a new version is uploaded on the EDM.

item.description:
Error management is harmonized across api calls.

When an error raises, two behaviors are implemented and are used in the differents api calls:

  • a full rollback is done on all actions executed until the raised error
  • the process continue on next steps

Error message informs the user with the following info:

  • a HTTP error code (400, 500, ...)
  • an internal API error code
  • an error message that briefly explains the abnormality encountered
  • a list of complementary data that should help to understand the error

The internal API error code can be a static code (mostly on error 4xx) or a construct one (internal error 500).

HTTP status code summary

Code Details
2xx Success
4xx Error that failed given the information provided
5xx Error with our servers

List of the static code:

Code Details Can be raised when uploading media?
INVALID_INSTANCE_STATE The state of the entity {Entity} is not valid. Parameters sent to endpoints are not consistent No
UNKNOWN_COMMON_OBSERVATION_ID_IN_ORGANIZATION Common observation Id {CommonObservationId} is unknown for business organization {BusinessOeganizationId}, trade {TradeId}. No
EMPTY_FILE The file {FileName} in section {FileSection} is empty Yes
FILE_EXTENSION The file type of {FileName} in section {FileSection} isn't permitted or the file's signature doesn't match the file's extension. Yes
BAD_HEADER The content-type header must be formated like : multipart/form-data; boundary=... Yes
MISSING_FILE_NAME The file name is missing in section {SectionName}. Yes
EMPTY_MULTIPART_FORM_DATA_CONTENT The MultipartFormDataContent is empty. Yes
MISSING_FILE_SECTION Section {ContentDisposition} in MultipartFormData is missing it's name. Yes

The construct code is composed by:

  • the called method code
  • the letters "ERR" (error) or "WRN" (warning). The choice depends on the capacity of the endpoint to rollback or not.
  • The number of encountered errors or warnings
  • Code examples : “GetOrga_WRN1”, “SetOrgaStatus_ERR2”

When an endpoint process doesn't rollback on error and can't execute any of its tasks, it returns a HTTP error code (500). But if it can process, at least one of its tasks, it returns a partial HTTP result code (206). This case appears when endpoints treat a list of elements.

item.name: Differential behavior
item.description:
Differential management is harmonized across many API calls.

These API calls are reconized by an endpoint parameter named: continuous_token.
You can use the endpoint for pagination and then for differential.

For pagination

The first time you use the endpoint, you only need to set the limit (ie the maximal number of elements returned) if you want a different limit than default value (50).
The endpoint will return the following response:

  • A boolean "need_to_relaunch" to inform you if there are still values to retrieve

  • A text "continuous_token" to use on your next call

  • A number "count" the number of returned elements

  • A number "total_count" for the total number of possible elements across all calls

Next time you simply use the same endpoint with the same limit and the new continuous_token

For differential

The call is identical to the last pagination call. Simply use the last continuous_token received and you will get only the elements modified/added/deleted since your last request.

Sample

Here we want to use the differential to get the observation list.

First call

curl -L 'https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/projects/:project_id/observations?limit=10' \
     -H 'X-API-Key: "API Key"' \
     -H 'Authorization: token "API Key"' \

Response

{
    "observations": [
        { obs datas },
        { obs datas },
        etc.
    ],
    "need_to_relaunch": true,
    "continuous_token": "0|10",
    "count": 10,
    "total_count": 25
}

Second call (needed as need_to_relaunch previously returned is true)

curl -L 'https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/projects/:project_id/observations?limit=10&continous_token=0|10' \
     -H 'X-API-Key: "API Key"' \
     -H 'Authorization: token "API Key"' \

Response

{
    "observations": [
        { obs datas },
        { obs datas },
        etc.
    ],
    "need_to_relaunch": true,
    "continuous_token": "0|20",
    "count": 10,
    "total_count": 25
}

Third call (needed as need_to_relaunch previously returned is true, and the last one as need_to_relaunch will be returned as false)

curl -L 'https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/projects/:project_id/observations?limit=10&continous_token=0|20' \
     -H 'X-API-Key: "API Key"' \
     -H 'Authorization: token "API Key"' \

Response

{
    "observations": [
        { obs datas },
        { obs datas },
        etc.
    ],
    "need_to_relaunch": false,
    "continuous_token": "638524961987950970|0",
    "count": 5,
    "total_count": 25
}

Later, call for differential

curl -L 'https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/projects/:project_id/observations?limit=10&continous_token=638524961987950970|0' \
     -H 'X-API-Key: "API Key"' \
     -H 'Authorization: token "API Key"' \

Response (but unlukily , no modified elements)

{
    "observations": [],
    "need_to_relaunch": false,
    "continuous_token": "638524961987950970|0",
    "count": 0,
    "total_count": 0
}

item.description:
Most content users can create is inside a module.

The goal of a module is to group items of the same type in one place. It's also a way to set the home page users will see in their project.

Currently, it's possible to define modules of the form type available for your project.

Regarding modules of the observation type, you can't manage them yet in a library, but they can be chosen at project creation among Finalcad modules. Users can also autonomously create observation type modules within their project.

Finalcad provides default templates to ease the setup steps of a project or an organization. Default values set at project creation are defined at the organization level. This way, we ensure strong consistency across projects and therefore a global digital strategy. If you already have projects with items in your organization, updating libraries will affect subsequently created items.

Based on a form ID, you can fill the different fields of the form. Here is the list of field types you can fill from the API:

  • Short answer

  • Paragraph

  • Single choice

  • Multiple choice

  • Control

  • Phone

  • Email

  • Disclaimer

  • Grid

  • Signature

  • Linked files

To do so, you have to get the field ID and type by using the "Get form answer" endpoint. Include the following info in the endpoint.

Endpoint mandatory info Details
project_id The ID of the project where the form has been created
Body mandatory info Details
form_instance_id The ID of the form instance
field_id The ID of the field you want to update

Depending on type_field_presentation and type_field_data for each field you have to fill in the endpoint the following information

Type type_field_data type_field_presentation Other field data Value to fill in the endpoint
Text Text ShortAnswer value_string
Paragraph Text Paragraph value_string
Phone number Text PhoneNumber value_string
Email Text Email value_string
Number Number ShortAnswer value_numeric
Date Calendar ShortAnswer form_field_sa_calendar.format_calendar
=DateOnly		 value_date1
Time Calendar ShortAnswer form_field_sa_calendar.format_calendar
=TimeOnly		 value_time1
Date&Time Calendar ShortAnswer form_field_sa_calendar.format_calendar
=DateAndTime		 value_date1 and value_time1
RadioButton Text SingleChoice array_field_choices
Checkboxes Text MultipleChoice array_field_choices
OkKo (control)
OkKoNeutral		 Text Control array_field_choices
OkKo+NA Text Control form_field_sa_control.na_values_allowed=true na_value/ array_field_choices
Grid Resources FormLink
Disclaimer Text Disclaimer value_boolean
Linked file Resources Attachments see below
Signature Resources Signature see below
Theses fields can not be set
formula Text Formula

For attaching files to a linked files field
first, create a text answer for the field
next,use the 'link file to answer' to attach a media
repeat theses 2 steps for attaching another file

For attaching files to to a signature field
first, create a text answer for the field
next,use the 'link file to answer' to attach an image media

For attaching items to a control field
first, create an answer for the field
next,use the 'link item to answer' to attach an item
repeat the second step for attaching another item

For grid row creation,
the body should include 2 others keys :
create_form_template_instance with value=true
create_form_template_instance_for_grid with value=true

For grid field creation
the body should include 2 others keys
create_form_template_instance with value=true
form_template_instance_id with value returned in value_form_template_instance_id by the grid creation

It is not recommended to create a grid row without filling its fields

item.name: Upload a media
item.description:
In this task, you will learn how to upload media.
With these steps, you'll be able to upload files and use them as content for plans or documents.

How to retrieve a list of organizations
How to retrieve projects for a specific organization
How to upload a small media (a media with a size less or equal to 5 Mo)
How to upload an heavy media

You will use the following operations to upload medias:

HTTP Request Description
CASE 1
POST https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/projects/:project_id/medias/uploads upload a small media.
CASE 2
POST https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/projects/:project_id/medias/uploadinit Init the upload of an heavy media.
POST https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/projects/:project_id/medias/:media_id/uploadappend Upload part of the media
POST https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/projects/:project_id/medias/:media_id/uploadterminate Terminate and validate the upload.

Case 1 - Upload a small media

To upload a small media, make this request.

Request

curl -L https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/projects/:project_id/medias/uploads \ 
     -H 'X-API-Key: "API Key"' \
     -H 'Authorization: token "API Key"' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
     -F 'stream="binary content of the file"'

Response

{ "id": "3019742b-8567-413b-8c40-af46acb58d2c", 
  "file_name": "name.extension", 
  "mime_type": "application/dwg" 
}

Note : id is the id the uploaded media

Case 2 - Step 1 - Init the upload of a heavy media

You should initiate the upload process, then upload all parts, and then validate the process.

Request

curl -L https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/projects/:project_id/medias/uploadinit \ 
     -H 'X-API-Key: "API Key"' \
     -H 'Authorization: token "API Key"' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
     -d '{ "file_name": "name of the file", 
           "total_bytes": total_size_of_the_file, 
           "md5" : "computed md5 of the full file" 
         }'

Response

{ "expires_after_secs": 3600, 
  "chunk_id": "cc1aca15-a9f2-41b2-8968-c3905545b376", 
  "media_id": "03457d15-6ee1-4860-ba24-f554bf595962", 
  "min_chunk_size": 5242880 
}

Case 2 - Step 2 - Upload heavy media parts (named chunks)

You should upload all the file parts, one by one.
Each part (except the last one) should have exactly a size of 5242880.
The first segment_index should be 1.

Request

curl -L https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/projects/:project_id/medias/:media_id/uploadappend \ 
     -H 'X-API-Key: "API Key"' \
     -H 'Authorization: token "API Key"' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
     -F 'chunk_id="cc1aca15-a9f2-41b2-8968-c3905545b376"' \ 
     -F 'segment_index="1"' \ 
     -F 'last_chunk="false"' \ 
     -F 'stream="binary content"' \ 
     -F 'md5="computed md5 of the part"'

Response

204 no content

Case 2 - Step 3 - Validate the heavy media upload

Request

curl -L https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/projects/:project_id/medias/:media_id/uploadterminate \ 
     -H 'X-API-Key: "API Key"' \
     -H 'Authorization: token "API Key"' \
     -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
     -d '{ "chunk_id" : "cc1aca15-a9f2-41b2-8968-c3905545b376" }'

Response

{ "id": "03457d15-6ee1-4860-ba24-f554bf595962", 
  "file_name": "lang1.png", 
  "mime_type": "image/png" 
}

Note: You can use this method to upload small media files as well.

item.name: Use a custom dashboard template in Power BI
Retrieve data in Power BI
item.description:
In this task, you will learn how to fetch Finalcad data from an organization by navigating through various API endpoints. By the end of this task, you will know:

How to configure datasets generation
How to get datasets files
How to add this dataset as source in Power BI

You will use the following operations to use datasets:

HTTP Request Description
POST https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/organizations/:organization_id/data/config Configure datasets generation on your organization.
GET https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api//organizations/:organization_id/data/config/dataset?name=Projects Get specific dataset url file

Step 1 - Configure dataset generation

To enable datasets generation, you can select the desired datasets with this request.

-H 'X-API-Key: your_api_key' \

Datasets are generated once a day at 6 a.m.

Step 2 - Add dataset as source in Power BI

To add a Finalcad dataset as a source in Power BI, start by selecting "Get Data" and then add an empty request.

Then click on "Advanced Editor" and copy-paste the following code.

let
    dataset_name = "dataset_name",
    api_key = "your_api_key",
    organization_id = "your_organization_id",
    RetryRequest = (retries as number) =>
    let
        apiResponse = try Json.Document(Web.Contents("https://developer.finalcad.cloud/api/organizations/" & organization_id & "/data/config/dataseturl?name=" & dataset_name, 
            [Headers=[#"X-API-Key"= api_key, Authorization="token " & api_key]])),
        Source = if apiResponse[HasError] and retries > 0 then
            Function.InvokeAfter(() => @RetryRequest(retries - 1), #duration(0, 0, 0, 2))
        else Parquet.Document(Binary.Buffer(Web.Contents(apiResponse[Value][url])))
    in
        Source,
    Source = RetryRequest(3)
in
    Source

Don't forget to replace:

  • your_organization_id with your organization ID

  • your_api_key with your API key

  • dataset_name with the dataset name you want to load

If you encounter a warning popup, click on it to confirm that the connection is made anonymously. The authentication is handled through the query defined above.

To make it easier for your organization to pull Finalcad One data, we’ve got a dashboard template ready for you in Microsoft Power BI.

Starting from this template, you can tweak the dashboard however you want: add charts and filters, or edit the ones that are already there.

You can also add your own data sources to visualize the data of your choice in a single Power BI file.

To learn more, you can:

  • Visualize the custom dashboard here

  • Discover the structure of the Power BI template here
